findings.requirement: Native current-state capacity must recover without deleting retained authority or relocating a permanent denial to new admissions.
findings.accepted_component: Compact only dominated session state that no fence or nonterminal operation retains. Preserve imported and cross-principal taint.
remaining_acceptance: Typed retryable refusal before global capacity, per-principal sharing and completion reservation for admitted work including parked approval.

Lineage and principal/epoch history remain authoritative. Authenticated cold state requires reviewed version/location commitments, bounded point proofs, cross-tier transition uniqueness and atomic recovery.
Account for declassification lifetime replay and spend records; no silent exemption from capacity acceptance.
findings.ruling: Compaction and pre-admission refusal alone do not close this finding. Cold-state implementation is not yet approved; design must resolve stale resurrection and unbounded epoch/startup scans.

findings.requirement: Every admitted passport and certification record retains terminal revocation capacity and exact reopen.
remaining_acceptance: Review and compose per-record terminal reserve with genuine Original tests and strict owning lint.

Preserve legacy files: a no-regression fallback may permit revocation that fits, but cannot guarantee a growing terminal write for an old file already at the read cap. Retain this as open pending a reviewed migration or explicit acceptance decision.
findings.ruling: No read-cap increase, deletion of signed records or assertion that new-write headroom covers every old file.

findings.requirement: An existing principal must refresh and join a legitimate second lineage; missing epoch state for an already materialized session or context must still refuse.

original_evidence.failure: second lineage refresh refused: native security state IntegrityFailure
original_evidence.scope: Actual kernel refresh after first-lineage join; producer log independently inspected by integrator.

findings.requirement: Concurrent passport/certification publication, dispute or revocation cannot overwrite successful terminal revocation; capacity decisions use the same current transaction.
findings.observation: The mutation handlers load, modify and replace registry files without a shared transaction or stale-write check. A later stale publisher can overwrite a successful revocation. This is source triage, not a completed runtime test.
remaining_acceptance: Inventory all persistence mutation entry points, including CLI and separate processes, before choosing the transaction boundary.
Deterministic overlapping Original control, repaired terminal-state and capacity controls, owning strict lint and composition.

qualification_boundary: This checkpoint records open acceptance and a genuine Original failure. It does not establish a runtime repair, full candidate approval, hosted success or merge. KANI-PROOF-QUAL remains OPEN/UNPROVED under the owner amendment; no proof campaign was run.
